title: SOS positive-control GETs need wait_for timeout (93s stall on regression)
description: Edge review of a2w2 fix: the added positive-control GETs in test_non_post_dropped_over_stack (python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py ~lines 615, 632) await .response with no timeout. If the SUT wedges, aiocoap CON retransmission exhaustion takes ~93s (MAX_TRANSMIT_WAIT) before RequestTimedOut, and no pytest-timeout is configured — a regression stalls the suite instead of failing fast. Fix: wrap both control GETs in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=...) matching the 1.0s discipline of the drop wait at line ~628.
close_reason: Fixed: both positive-control GETs in test_non_post_dropped_over_stack wrapped in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=1.0), matching the drop probe's discipline — a wedged SUT now fails in ~1s instead of stalling ~93s in aiocoap CON retransmission. No shield on the GETs (they should be cancelled on timeout, unlike the drop probe where timeout is the expected oracle). 116/116 pass, ruff clean. Review (consolidated 3-aspect pass on the 4-line diff): PASS.
